subject: Request to Amend Draft Bill of Lading – PO 26067 – Coated Ivory Board – 138MT
body:
Dear Shipping Line,

I hope you are well. I am writing regarding the draft Bill of Lading for PO 26067 (Coated Ivory Board, 138MT).

I noticed that the draft Bill of Lading does not match our Shipping Instruction. Specifically, the Consignee and Notify Party are listed as 'UAB NOVAKOPA', but our Shipping Instruction states they should be 'EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC'.

Could you please amend the draft Bill of Lading so that both the Consignee and Notify Party read 'EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC'? This will ensure it matches our Shipping Instruction.

Thank you for your help. Please let me know if you need anything else from us.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Company]
